claims.claim: Core Draft 0.17 is current qualified Core authority under IsoGraph's repository qualification system.
claims.oracle: Frozen repository qualification obligations, packets, scorers, and review
claims.falsifier: A later qualified Core authority supersedes it, or its recorded qualification provenance is invalidated under the repository's own rules.
limitations: Qualified repository authority is not independent external validation of the general formal claims.

claims.claim: Modules named by the qualified-module manifest passed their frozen repository qualification campaigns at the recorded revisions/hashes.
claims.oracle: Frozen qualification campaigns and manifest provenance
claims.falsifier: Manifest/hash mismatch, invalid qualification provenance, or superseding qualified authority changes the applicable status.
limitations: Cold/model/provider isolation improves execution independence but does not create external authority.

claims.claim: IsoGraph's general formal and structural claims have independent external validation.
claims.falsifier: Failure against an independent external oracle, counterexample, or failed third-party reproduction rejects the corresponding external claim.
limitations: Internal qualification and model-to-model review are not by themselves external validation.
